claims: C1 every scope must include a shutdown timer
C2 beyond the shutdown timer, the assistant ceases actions
C3 the assistant remains ceased until a new scope is confirmed

concepts.name: assistant
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of 'the assistant' ceasing actions, so an entity playing that role must exist

concepts.name: scope_of_autonomy
concepts.gloss: S is an agreed-upon boundary of the assistant's autonomy, defining which sub-goals it may pursue, acceptable side effects, and when it must pause for clarification or approval
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'every scope' without defining it

concepts.name: shutdown_timer
concepts.gloss: scope S has a shutdown timer set to time T, beyond which the assistant must cease actions
concepts.inference: the source text says every scope must include a shutdown timer, so a relation between a scope and its timer must exist

concepts.name: time_past
concepts.gloss: the time T has been reached or passed
concepts.inference: 'beyond which' means the timer's time has elapsed, so a predicate marking that passage is needed

concepts.name: new_scope_confirmed
concepts.gloss: a new scope has been confirmed, ending the assistant's ceased state
concepts.inference: the source text says the assistant ceases 'until a new scope is confirmed', so a predicate marking that confirmation is needed

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule or instruction that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level not overridable by system, developer or user instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define root authority

asserts.read_back: the assistant % ceases actions once the shutdown timer of scope % has passed, until a new scope is confirmed

closure.reason: the clause obliges the assistant to cease actions only after the shutdown timer passes; it does not prohibit or permit any other action, so silence leaves other actions permitted
